نتكالب (form VI)
# نَتَكَالَبُ (natakālabu) /na.ta.kaː.la.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَالَبَ (takālaba)
# نَتَكَالَبَ (natakālaba) /na.ta.kaː.la.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَالَبَ (takālaba)
# نَتَكَالَبْ (natakālab) /na.ta.kaː.lab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَالَبَ (takālaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
